component.name: Lune
component.summary: Fast, gapless music player for your library

description.p: Lune is a fast, focused player for the music you already have. It plays MP3, FLAC, AAC and ALAC (M4A), Ogg Vorbis, WAV, and AIFF without gaps between tracks, and only ever reads your files: no tag editing, and no changes to your music.

ul.li: Browse by album artist, artist, album, year, genre, or file type, or see what you added or played recently
Search as you type, and show albums as a list or as a grid of covers
A play queue kept apart from browsing, with shuffle and repeat, that picks up where you left off
Playlists you can build and reorder from anywhere in the library
Watched library folders: new and changed files show up on their own, and music on a disconnected drive waits for it to come back
Media keys and the system's Now Playing controls
